description:
Cast The Goose Mother either from your hand or from the command zone by paying at least {5}{G}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When The Goose Mother enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three Clue, three Food and three Treasure tokens.
Activate three Foods, three Clues and three Treasures by tapping them, adding {6}{G}{G}{U}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning The Goose Mother from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
